summary: Full backend and frontend testing of HCA (Hybrid Cognitive Agent) system. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified with complete chat flow working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 328 lines which is acceptable, but as features grow consider splitting HCA endpoints into a separate router file

The first button click via playwright force=True didn't trigger form submission — minor UX note: the submit button click works fine via keyboard Enter, but force click on disabled-looking button might confuse users (button was not actually disabled)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core HCA flows verified: basic run→completed, approval flow (remember goal → awaiting_approval → approve → completed), memory retrieval returns hits array, GET run by id, 404 for missing run. Frontend: Cognitive Agent Console loads, badges Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini Flash present, goal-input and submit-goal-btn functional, user-bubble and agent-card appear with plan details (strategy, action) and COMPLETED state badge.
